meta.method: Hotels ranked by Michelin proximity score = weighted count of starred restaurants in the hotel's home cluster (3★=3, 2★=2, 1★=1) + 50% weight for adjacent clusters. Counts derived from data/restaurants.json (2026). Distances are cluster-level, not surveyed miles — see hotels.html methodology and Flagged page.

East Bay.breakdown: 1×2★ (Commis) + 2×1★ (Sun Moon Studio + Wakuriya is Peninsula; East Bay proper = Commis + Sun Moon = 2) — see note

Peninsula / South Bay.breakdown: 5×1★ (Selby's, Protégé, Wakuriya, Plumed Horse, Village Pub)

Monterey / Carmel + Mendocino.breakdown: 1×2★ Aubergine + 1×1★ Chez Noir + 1×2★ Harbor House + 1×1★ Madcap (Marin) — grouped for coastal ranking
